articles.title: Elon Musk's X is exploring stablecoins to pay influencers and content providers
articles.snippet: Conversations with X are ongoing, according to a person who also works with other social media platforms testing stablecoins to pay influencers.

articles.title: HSBC, Standard Chartered execute first live banking transaction on Swift’s 24/7 ledger
articles.snippet: The cross-border transaction is Swift’s first in a pilot project as it tests settlement in its push to remain relevant as stablecoins and tokenized deposits become widely used worldwide.

articles.title: Bitcoin.com integrates UAE-registered US dollar stablecoin into self-custodial wallet
articles.snippet: The integration expands access to USDU, the UAE’s first central bank-registered US dollar stablecoin, as it builds distribution beyond institutional channels.

articles.title: OCC head promises final GENIUS rules by November
articles.snippet: The US banking regulator released a 376‑page proposal in February, calling for public comment on rules to implement the stablecoin bill ahead of its January 2027 effective date.

articles.title: Banking Regulator Races to Finalize GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules
articles.snippet: OCC Comptroller Jonathan Gould told the Wyoming Blockchain Symposium the agency is moving at a rapid pace to beat a January statutory deadline, after already missing an earlier July target.
